caption_L1: This bar chart is labeled Revenue of the Houston Rockets from 2001/02 to 2018/19 (in million U.S. dollars). There is a categorical scale starting at 01/02 and ending at 18/19 along the x-axis, labeled Year. Revenue in million U.S. dollars is shown along the y-axis.
